text.en: Pet owners consistently commend the quality of styling and coat maintenance provided at the salon. Reviews note precise haircut finishes for doodles and effective dematting treatments that preserve coat appearance without unnecessary close shaving. Clients also appreciate regular nail trims that leave paws tidy and comfortable.

Reviewers highlight the welcoming attitude and attentive demeanor shown by salon staff, including individual groomer Angie. Clients appreciate that groomers listen carefully to styling preferences and offer non-judgmental guidance for challenging coat conditions. Returning pet owners value the steady familiarity and kindness shown to pets.

Owners emphasize the team's patient approach when handling nervous dogs and cautious cats during grooming appointments. Reviews describe how groomers take extra time to soothe anxious animals, keeping stress levels low during nail clipping and coat detangling. Pets return home calm and quickly resume their normal domestic routines.

q.en: Does the salon offer self-wash facilities for dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients mention using the self-wash stations, noting clean wash areas and good-quality grooming products.

q.en: Can groomers safely handle matted cat fur?

a.en: Reviewers report that staff handle matted cats gently, removing tight tangles effectively without resorting to extensive shaving.

q.en: Is parking readily available near the salon?

a.en: Yes, clients note that plenty of parking spaces are available outside the Roosevelt Road premises in Liberty Station.

q.en: Can owners book quick walk-in nail trims?

a.en: Pet parents frequently bring their dogs in for routine nail trims, praising the staff for swift and gentle clipping.
